<span class="origin-badge origin-badge--bareos">Bareos</span>

Mount storage.

## Synopsis

```text
mount [storage=<storage>] [sd=<sd>] [<storage-name>] [slot=<slot>]
      [drive=<drive>] [device=<device>] [jobid=<jobid>] [job=<job>]
      [ujobid=<ujobid>]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Asks the Storage Daemon to use a device again: on tape drives to read the loaded tape and make it available to jobs, on autochangers to load a volume from a slot first (slot=). Needed after unmount, after inserting a tape, or when a job waits for a volume. It changes the device state in the Storage Daemon, not the catalog. File devices are always mounted.

The storage is given as storage=, sd= or by its bare name; without it a selection list appears. jobid=, job= or ujobid= use the storage of a running job. A keyword without a value is read as a storage name.

Onesimus deviation: a job waiting for a volume whose Job resource has no Max Wait Time is cancelled after 10 minutes (unlimited in Bareos). Until then mount or a newly labelled volume lets the job continue.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `storage=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage name. |
| `sd=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage name (as storage=). |
| `<storage-name>` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  | positional | Storage name without key. |
| `slot=` | integer |  |  |  | Slot. |
| `drive=` | integer |  |  |  | Drive number. |
| `device=` | string |  |  |  | Device name. |
| `jobid=` | integer |  |  |  | Storage of a job. |
| `job=` | resource | from [`.jobs`](../dot-jobs/) |  |  | Storage of a job. |
| `ujobid=` | string |  |  |  | Storage of a job. |

## Examples

Load slot 3 into drive 0 and mount it:

```text
mount storage=Autochanger slot=3 drive=0
```

Mount the storage the running job 42 waits on:

```text
mount jobid=42
```
